function factFor(it,eraIdx){
 var p=POOL[it.icon];var era=NM(eraIdx);
 if(it.note)return p.n+': '+it.note;
 if(it.ok)return p.n+': '+p.f+'. It belongs in this scene.';

}

   });
   s+='</div><p class="note">'+SCENES.filter(function(q){return st.cleared.indexOf(K(q.era))>=0;}).length+' / 42 scenes cleared. 40 scenes have painted-in objects; 2 original scenes keep icons.</p>';

function tap(ix){
 if(A.over)return;
 var sc=SCENES[A.era],it=sc.items[ix];
 if(A.found[ix])return;

 else{A.found[ix]=1;A.foundCount++;A.last=factFor(it,A.era);

     var st=sv();var score=500-A.wrongs*50;
     if(!(st.best[K(A.era)]>=score))st.best[K(A.era)]=score;
     if(st.cleared.indexOf(K(A.era))<0)st.cleared.push(K(A.era));
     save(st);
     try{PAS.add('anx|'+K(A.era),'Anachronist: '+NM(A.era)+', points',score,'pts',false,score+' pts, '+A.wrongs+' mistakes');}catch(e){}
   }
 }
 window.render();
}
/* Correct only Anachronist rank direction; keep saved run rows. */
(function(){try{var k='pa.scores.timelab.v1',raw=localStorage.getItem(k);if(!raw)return;var o=JSON.parse(raw),changed=false;if(!o||typeof o!=='object'||Array.isArray(o))return;Object.keys(o).forEach(function(id){var b=o[id];if(id.indexOf('anx|')!==0||!b||!Array.isArray(b.r)||b.low!==true)return;b.low=false;b.r.sort(function(a,c){return c.s-a.s});changed=true;});if(changed)localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(o));}catch(e){}})();
XL.reg('anx',{
 open:function(){A.era=null;A.found={};A.foundCount=0;A.wrongs=0;A.over=false;A.last='';},
 close:function(){A.era=null;},
 render:render
});
XL.anx={
 stageTap:function(ev){
  if(A.over||A.era===null||(A.era===24||A.era===22))return;
  var st=document.getElementById('anxstage');if(!st)return;
  var r=st.getBoundingClientRect();
  var x=(ev.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100,y=(ev.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100;
  var sc=SCENES[A.era],best=-1,bd=1e9;
  sc.items.forEach(function(it,ix){var b=BOUNDS[A.era][ix],dx=(it.x-x)/b[0],dy=(it.y-y)/b[1],d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(Math.abs(dx)<=1&&Math.abs(dy)<=1&&d<bd){bd=d;best=ix;}});
  if(best>=0){tap(best);}
  else{A.wrongs++;A.last='Nothing out of time there. (-50)';window.render();}
 },
 start:function(i){A.era=i;A.found={};A.foundCount=0;A.wrongs=0;A.over=false;A.last='';try{if(i<25)age=i;}catch(e){}window.render();scrollTo(0,0);},
 menu:function(){A.era=null;window.render();scrollTo(0,0);},
 tap:tap,
 next:function(){var st=sv();for(var i=0;i<PTOT;i++){if(st.cleared.indexOf(K((A.era+1+i)%PTOT))<0){XL.anx.start((A.era+1+i)%PTOT);return;}}XL.anx.menu();}
};
})();

</script>
